title: waiver/v1
description: nodes/<id>/waivers/native_decide.yaml (D-4 native_decide amendment; F02-R8): the recorded justification for a proof that trusts the compiler. The one file a submission may add beyond Proof.lean, and only when the proof uses native_decide. The approving review names it (`waiver: native_decide`) and the attestation carries trust_base: compiler permanently. Free text is contributor-supplied and served as untrusted data (D-28).

justification.description: Why the kernel cannot check this (typically: a computation the kernel cannot reduce in reasonable time)

author.description: The submitter asserting the justification (D-19, D-22)
